name: Continual App template styleguide
purpose: Rendered reference for primitives, blocks, themes, charts, data tables, app surfaces, marketing surfaces, and chat UI.
requiredInteractions: Tabs switch between table, empty, loading, chart, and data-table panels.
Dialog and sheet open and close.
Data table search, sorting, selection, and pagination respond.
Mobile viewport has no page-level horizontal overflow.
visualGuardrails: App surfaces use compact headers instead of marketing heroes.
App surfaces avoid rounded-2xl or larger custom wrappers.
App surfaces avoid text-4xl or larger headings.
App surfaces avoid py-20 or larger vertical padding.
